definitions.explanation: One of the colored segments that form a flower. Petals protect the reproductive parts and attract pollinators.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{花弁|かべん}が{風|かぜ}に{舞|ま}っている。
examples.english: Cherry blossom petals are dancing in the wind.

examples.japanese: この{花|はな}は{花弁|かべん}が{五枚|ごまい}ある。
{花弁|かべん}が{散|ち}り{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The petals have started to fall.

notes:
{花弁|かべん} refers to flower petals.

Alternative reading: {花弁|はなびら} (more colloquial)

Common expressions:
- {花弁|かべん}が{散|ち}る (petals scatter/fall)
- {花弁|かべん}が{開|ひら}く (petals open)
- {一重|ひとえ} (single-petaled)
- {八重|やえ} (double-petaled, many petals)

Counter: {枚|まい}

Note:
{花弁|かべん} is the formal/scientific term, while {花弁|はなびら} is more commonly used in everyday speech. The poetic image of cherry blossom petals ({桜|さくら}の{花弁|はなびら}) scattering in the wind is iconic in Japanese culture.
